description: One call before you buy a Base token: overall risk rating (low/medium/high) with named flags, on-chain facts (owner, renounced, paused, proxy, mint/blacklist/fee-setter heuristics), plus live DEX market data: price, 24h volume and change, total liquidity, FDV, pair count and age, and 24h buys vs sells. Flags no-liquidity, thin liquidity, new pairs and no-sell patterns. Heuristic screening, not a guarantee. Costs $0.02 in USDC on Base per successful call, paid with x402.
name: token-report
